name: upsertDocumentType
body: mutation upsertDocumentType($id: ID!, $name: String) { dictionaryPacket { updateOrCreateDocumentType(input: { id: $id, name: $name }) { created returning { id name } } } }

name: refDocumentTypeListGet
body: query refDocumentTypeListGet { searchDocumentType { elems { id name } count } }

name: upsertDocumentProcessSettings
body: mutation upsertDocumentProcessSettings($id: ID!, $documentType: ID!, $processId: String, $enabled: Boolean) { dictionaryPacket { updateOrCreateDocumentProcessSettings(input: { id: $id, documentType: $documentType, processId: $processId, enabled: $enabled }) { created returning { id documentType { id name } processId enabled } } } }

name: searchDocumentProcessSettings
body: query searchDocumentProcessSettings($offset: Int, $limit: Int, $cond: String) { searchDocumentProcessSettings(offset: $offset, limit: $limit, cond: $cond) { elems { id documentType { id name } processId enabled } count } }

name: searchPdsContract
body: query searchPdsContract($offset: Int, $limit: Int, $cond: String, $sort: [_SortCriterionSpecification!]) { searchPdsContract(offset: $offset, limit: $limit, cond: $cond, sort: $sort) { elems { id document { id documentId documentType { id name } createdBy createdAt version changeToken } contractDate contractNumber snils status } count } }

name: createPdsContract
body: mutation createPdsContract($document: _CreateDocumentInput!, $input: _CreatePdsContractInput!, $command: _CreateDocumentCommandInput!) { packet { createDocument(input: $document) { id documentId } createPdsContract(input: $input) { id status } createDocumentCommand(input: $command) { id } } }

name: updatePdsContract
body: mutation updatePdsContract($input: _UpdatePdsContractInput!) { packet { updatePdsContract(input: $input) { id status } } }

name: createAttachment
body: mutation createAttachment($input: _CreateAttachmentInput!) { packet { createAttachment(input: $input) { id attachmentId logicalAttachmentId documentId fileName contentType size storageReference version current uploadedAt } } }

checkSelects.description: Only assigned operator can create attachments while document is in work

name: searchAttachment
body: query searchAttachment($cond: String, $offset: Int, $limit: Int) { searchAttachment(cond: $cond, offset: $offset, limit: $limit) { elems { id attachmentId logicalAttachmentId documentId fileName contentType size storageReference version current uploadedAt } count } }

name: replaceAttachmentVersion
body: mutation replaceAttachmentVersion($currentAttachmentId: ID!, $input: _CreateAttachmentInput!) { packet { updateAttachment(input: { id: $currentAttachmentId, current: false }) { id attachmentId logicalAttachmentId documentId version current } createAttachment(input: $input) { id attachmentId logicalAttachmentId documentId fileName contentType size storageReference version current uploadedAt } } }

checkSelects.description: Only current attachment version can be replaced
Only assigned operator can replace attachments while document is in work

name: deleteAttachment
body: mutation deleteAttachment($id: ID!, $documentId: String!) { packet { deleteAttachment(id: $id) } }

checkSelects.description: Only attachments of the requested document can be deleted
Only assigned operator can delete attachments while document is in work

name: searchDocumentVersion
body: query searchDocumentVersion($cond: String, $offset: Int, $limit: Int) { searchDocumentVersion(cond: $cond, offset: $offset, limit: $limit) { elems { id documentId version schemaVersion attributes attachments createdBy createdAt closedAt } count } }

name: searchDocumentCommand
body: query searchDocumentCommand($cond: String) { searchDocumentCommand(cond: $cond) { elems { commandKey requestHash response history document { documentId } } count } }

name: initializeDocumentVersion
body: mutation initializeDocumentVersion($id: ID!, $token: String!, $compare: _CompareDocumentInput!, $version: _CreateDocumentVersionInput!) { packet { updateDocument(input: { id: $id, version: 1, changeToken: $token }, compare: $compare) { id } createDocumentVersion(input: $version) { id } } }

checkSelects.description: Initialize only a document without application versions

name: commitDocumentAttributes
body: mutation commitDocumentAttributes($details: _UpdatePdsContractInput!, $detailsCompare: _ComparePdsContractInput!, $document: _UpdateDocumentInput!, $compare: _CompareDocumentInput!, $version: _CreateDocumentVersionInput!, $previous: _UpdateDocumentVersionInput!, $command: _CreateDocumentCommandInput!) { packet { updateDocument(input: $document, compare: $compare) { id } updatePdsContract(input: $details, compare: $detailsCompare) { id } createDocumentVersion(input: $version) { id } updateDocumentVersion(input: $previous) { id } createDocumentCommand(input: $command) { id } } }

name: commitDocumentNoChange
body: mutation commitDocumentNoChange($document: _UpdateDocumentInput!, $compare: _CompareDocumentInput!, $command: _CreateDocumentCommandInput!) { packet { updateDocument(input: $document, compare: $compare) { id } createDocumentCommand(input: $command) { id } } }

name: commitDocumentFileUpload
body: mutation commitDocumentFileUpload($document: _UpdateDocumentInput!, $compare: _CompareDocumentInput!, $previous: _UpdateDocumentVersionInput!, $file: _CreateAttachmentInput!, $command: _CreateDocumentCommandInput!) { packet { updateDocument(input: $document, compare: $compare) { id } updateDocumentVersion(input: $previous) { id } createAttachment(input: $file) { id } createDocumentCommand(input: $command) { id } } }

name: commitDocumentFileReplace
body: mutation commitDocumentFileReplace($document: _UpdateDocumentInput!, $compare: _CompareDocumentInput!, $previous: _UpdateDocumentVersionInput!, $file: _CreateAttachmentInput!, $retired: _UpdateAttachmentInput!, $command: _CreateDocumentCommandInput!) { packet { updateDocument(input: $document, compare: $compare) { id } updateDocumentVersion(input: $previous) { id } createAttachment(input: $file) { id } updateAttachment(input: $retired) { id } createDocumentCommand(input: $command) { id } } }

name: commitDocumentFileDelete
body: mutation commitDocumentFileDelete($document: _UpdateDocumentInput!, $compare: _CompareDocumentInput!, $previous: _UpdateDocumentVersionInput!, $retired: _UpdateAttachmentInput!, $command: _CreateDocumentCommandInput!) { packet { updateDocument(input: $document, compare: $compare) { id } updateDocumentVersion(input: $previous) { id } updateAttachment(input: $retired) { id } createDocumentCommand(input: $command) { id } } }

name: searchDocument
body: query searchDocument($offset: Int, $limit: Int, $cond: String, $sort: [_SortCriterionSpecification!]) { searchDocument(offset: $offset, limit: $limit, cond: $cond, sort: $sort) { elems { id documentId documentType { id name } createdBy createdAt version changeToken kidOps { id contractNumber contractDate signingYear lastName firstName middleName snils status } pdsContract { id contractDate contractNumber snils status } } count } }

name: createKidOps
body: mutation createKidOps($document: _CreateDocumentInput!, $input: _CreateKidOpsInput!, $command: _CreateDocumentCommandInput!) { packet { createDocument(input: $document) { id documentId documentType { id name } } createKidOps(input: $input) { id status } createDocumentCommand(input: $command) { id } } }

name: updateKidOps
body: mutation updateKidOps($input: _UpdateKidOpsInput!) { packet { updateKidOps(input: $input) { id status } } }

name: commitKidOpsAttributes
body: mutation commitKidOpsAttributes($details: _UpdateKidOpsInput!, $detailsCompare: _CompareKidOpsInput!, $document: _UpdateDocumentInput!, $compare: _CompareDocumentInput!, $version: _CreateDocumentVersionInput!, $previous: _UpdateDocumentVersionInput!, $command: _CreateDocumentCommandInput!) { packet { updateDocument(input: $document, compare: $compare) { id } updateKidOps(input: $details, compare: $detailsCompare) { id } createDocumentVersion(input: $version) { id } updateDocumentVersion(input: $previous) { id } createDocumentCommand(input: $command) { id } } }
